rationale: A composition-derived ultimate-strength prior from an independent multi-principal-element-alloy corpus should reduce the number of steel yield-strength labels required for useful prediction.
Hardness is mechanically adjacent but less directly paired with yield strength.
Ductility is a same-domain property with a non-universal strength tradeoff.
Thermal transport is unrelated to steel mechanical strength.
Electrocatalytic selectivity is unrelated to steel mechanical strength.
